title: NoLBERT-Calls: Reading Earnings Calls Without Hindsight
abstract: arXiv:2611.19849v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models are now a standard tool for measuring what managers say on earnings calls, but the encoders behind these measures were usually pretrained on text from the same years a backtest covers. Holding out a test period does not remove that hindsight, because it sits in the features. We adapt NoLBERT, an encoder pretrained only on text published between 1976 and 1995, to earnings calls without letting it read anything dated after 31 December 2023. The calls supply the training signal themselves: every analyst question is followed by management's answer, and the model learns to pick that answer out from the other answers of the same call. We test on every US call from January 2025 to October 2026 (20,323 calls, 254,575 questions) and make every modeling choice on calls from 2024. The adapted model, NoLBERT-Calls-2023, ranks the true answer first for 78.0% of questions (95% interval 77.8-78.2; chance 8.0%), against 26.3% before adap

translated_title: NoLBERT-Calls：无后见之明地解读财报电话会议
translated_abstract: 语言模型如今已成为衡量管理层在财报电话会议上所言内容的标准工具，但这些度量所依赖的编码器通常是在与回测覆盖年份相同的文本上进行预训练的。即使保留出测试期，也无法消除这种后见之明，因为它已嵌入特征之中。我们调整了NoLBERT——一个仅在1976年至1995年间发表的文本上预训练的编码器——使其适配财报电话会议，且不让它阅读任何2023年12月31日之后的文本。电话会议本身提供训练信号：每个分析师提问之后都紧随管理层的回答，模型学习从同一场电话会议的其他回答中挑选出正确的那个回答。我们在2025年1月至2026年10月的所有美国电话会议（20,323场电话会议，254,575个问题）上进行测试，并在2024年的电话会议上做出所有建模选择。适配后的模型NoLBERT-Calls-2023在78.0%的问题上将正确回答排在第一位（95%区间为77.8-78.2；随机概率为8.0%），而适配前仅为26.3%……
tldr: 该论文提出NoLBERT-Calls-2023，通过仅使用2023年底之前的知识并利用财报电话会议自身的问答对进行自监督适配，消除了语言模型财务度量中的后见之明偏差，在254,575个问题上以78.0%的准确率正确匹配管理层回答。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces NoLBERT-Calls-2023, an encoder pretrained only on text published before 2024 and adapted to earnings calls through their own Q&A pairs, eliminating hindsight bias in language-model financial measures by correctly matching management's answers for 78.0% of 254,575 questions.
